paper_title: Search for ultralight dark matter with spectroscopy of radio-frequency atomic transitions
coupling_convention: dimensionless d_e, derived from delta_f/f ~ 8e-11 via Eq.(9)
notes: Paper constrains several couplings: scalar d_e (alpha variation -> ScalarPhoton, best bound from Dy/quartz, Fig 3a), d_me (ScalarElectron), d_g (ScalarNucleon/QCD scale), and a quadratic QCD axion-gluon coupling 1/f_phi (Fig 4). The strongest/headline result is on d_e via the Dy electronic transition (K_alpha=2.6e6), improving previous oscillation searches by up to ~3 orders of magnitude. No numerical table of the exclusion curve is provided; data points here are DERIVED from the quoted Dy sensitivity delta_f/f ~ 8e-11 (giving delta_alpha/alpha ~ 3e-17) using d_e = (delta_f/f) M_Pl m_phi / (2e6 * sqrt(2 rho_DM)), with rho_DM = 3e-6 eV^4 and a stochastic weakening factor ~4.4 below ~50 Hz. Bound scales linearly with mass (weaker/larger d_e at higher mass, exceeding 1 above ~1e-13 eV). Mass range for scalar search: 1e-17 to 8.3e-13 eV. Values approximate; treat plot-level accuracy as low. Multiple coupling types present so confidence limited. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.4, 4))
